validation: Adapted from the validated A100 4x1-GPU TP4 profile to the curiosity B300 partition: one node, 4 GPUs, docker runtime (vllm/vllm-openai v0.32.0, same image as glm53 so the router can serve both at once). Backport-only flags were dropped because stock v0.32 does not have them (kv fp8_ds_mla, --all2all-backend, --block-size 256, --language-model-only, --safetensors-load-strategy prefetch); the KV cache is left at the vLLM default. The parser names are not guessed: the launcher resolves them from the image's parser registry (candidates above) and verifies every remaining flag against `vllm serve --help=all` before loading weights, failing fast with the exact list if something is absent. NOT yet GPU-validated in this form; trust it only after a first READY endpoint and its API checks.
